nodes.question: In a sentence or two — what does your business sell, and who buys it?
What have you already tried to fix or grow this — courses, hires, a different offer, anything?
How do you price, and are you winning mostly on price, or on value?

branches.answer_pattern: pricing feels underpriced, commodity, or the owner wins mostly on being cheaper / can't justify a premium
offer feels differentiated and priced fairly — this isn't the block

nodes.question: Where do most of your leads come from, and is that flow consistent month to month?

branches.answer_pattern: inconsistent, mostly referrals or the owner's personal network, no repeatable channel
lead flow is fine and reasonably consistent — this isn't the block

nodes.question: Is revenue turning into real profit, or does it disappear somewhere?

branches.answer_pattern: revenue exists but margin is thin, inconsistent, or there's no real cash allocation discipline
margin is fine — this isn't the block

nodes.question: Walk me through your hours — what fraction of your week goes to things only you can do, versus things anyone could do?

branches.answer_pattern: the owner is mostly stuck on low-value, delegable tasks
the owner's time is already mostly high-leverage — this isn't the block

nodes.question: If you took two full weeks off with no contact, what happens to the business?

branches.answer_pattern: it mostly stops, nothing runs without the owner personally
it would mostly keep running — this isn't the block

nodes.question: Do you run a consistent weekly operating rhythm — a real review, real priorities — or does each week just happen to you?

branches.answer_pattern: no real rhythm, reactive week to week
already runs a disciplined weekly rhythm and is still stuck — the constraint isn't obviously any single module above
